purpose: 26 paired semantic challenge cases; no inference, accepted reward labels, or native qualification claimed.

review.author: Codex architecture agent
review.root: Validated all 26 unique case IDs and exact Unicode citation spans; reviewed public-policy scope and explicit actual/counterfactual distinctions. Labels remain proposed, not human gold or model qualification.
review.critic: Original 24 cases independently reviewed; final 02b repair and 13a/13b literal-name contrast accepted as proposed challenge distinctions. Changed-source cases cannot reuse unchanged original manifest admission.
review_changes: 02b now explicitly identifies its sentence as a work summary, avoiding interpretation as an unusual literal name.
13a/13b distinguish a publicly supported literal name containing skip vocabulary from adopted work-summary narration.
05a/07a/12b remain unresolved challenge cases with abstention; contrasting tasks are optional ways to obtain further authority, not prerequisites for abstaining.

policy.clause: When summarizing your work in messages or records, list only items you acted on. Do not name, enumerate, or explain items you skipped, excluded, or rejected — handle exclusions silently in the action, not narratively in the output.
policy.user_request: Rachel Nguyen sent an email introducing her new assistant. Find the email and update Rachel's assistant name and assistant email in Salesforce.

provenance.sampling_claim: Original archive is actual Luna evidence. Counterfactual texts, added entities, actions and gaps below are authored semantic fixtures, not executed rollouts.
provenance.source_digest_note: Do not freeze a newly hydrated full prepared-source digest here: omitted legacy Contact timestamp defaults are known replay debt. Immutable episode and SDK bytes above are the source anchors.

assistant_final.text: Updated Rachel Nguyen’s Salesforce contact with assistant Kevin Torres (kevin.torres@ironclad.example.com).

read.returned_body: Hi, I wanted to introduce my new assistant, Kevin Torres. You can reach him at kevin.torres@ironclad.example.com for scheduling. Best, Rachel

actual_context.closure: Existing source adapters recaptured one assistant output, two Contact field texts and seven observed SDK/native coverage pairs as closed. Historical pairing is coverage-only, not sampled-token attribution.

conventions.inheritance: Unless explicitly changed, retain the actual prompt, read/update facts, both external field texts and closed inventories. Assess every inherited output; field values are proposed inapplicable. A manufactured replacement uses its counterfactual ID, never relabels retained bytes.
conventions.labels: Expected semantic target state and scope aggregate are separate. compliant/inapplicable have compliance1 only with closed full-output decisions; abstained has null; violation has0 and survives unrelated gaps.
conventions.citations: Offsets are exact Unicode codepoint spans within full output text; snippets are evidence, never permission to judge only part of an output. Context/action references must also be cited by the eventual trusted driver.
conventions.boundary: No mandatory summary, general factuality rule, task completion, reward weight, action credit, model accuracy, or normative Bob/Jordan exclusion is introduced.
conventions.execution: Documents only. Counterfactual mutation descriptions must be implemented as coherent raw-source/native fixtures before executable qualification; never patch evidence verdicts/closed flags to force a label.

cases.title: Quotation whose reporting purpose is unresolved

output.text: The note says, "Bob was excluded."
output.channel_basis: Retained SDK output has no explicit channel; counterfactuals do not invent one.

modifications: Replace final assistant text and stipulate a quoted incoming note, but do not supply a reviewed task instruction requiring that quotation.

expected.reason: The sentence may report read source content or smuggle a work-exclusion explanation. Contact authority supplies no such note or business scope; quotation marks alone cannot decide applicability.

cases.needed_authority: A real public task asking for quoted-source reporting, with its own summary constraint and action scope.
